These create an explosion with a radius of 4 that apply a 20% [[Fatigue Debuff]] to towers for 5 seconds. |ability1_cooldown = 10 |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Heal Trail}}''' - The '''Blight Walker''' leaves a trail of puddles on the ground that last one second, which apply a short 0.1 second regeneration that heals any enemy that walks over them by 15 for its duration. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Blight Walker''' was an enemy that appeared on [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]] in the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a high amount of health and quite fast speed. It also had the [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Stun Immunity]], making it harder to slow down. On some waves, it also could spawn with the [[Bloated]] and [[Nimble]] attributes. It had two abilities. The first ability was ''Spit Burst'', which made it fire out three purple spit balls at towers. These created an explosion which applied a 20% [[Fatigue Debuff]] to towers, including non-humanoid towers, in a radius of 4. This debuff lasted 5 seconds. The second ability was ''Heal Trail'', which left a trail that applied a regeneration buff to an enemy. This regeneration lasted 0.1 seconds and only healed 15 health of an enemy. ==Appearance== The '''Blight Walker''' had maroon skin, with its appearance resembling that of an animal. It had four legs, large mouth and a tail. It wore a large skull with horns on its head, which had its jaw on its torso. It also had a few bones attached to its legs. It wore brown bandages around its legs. It wore grey shoulder-pads with spikes and a grey chestplate. It left a trail of purple goo as it walked. ==Strategy== *The '''Blight Walker''' is a fast enemy with high health, high range or fast firing towers like the [[Ranger]], [[Gatling Gun]] and [[Mortar]] are best to kill it. **Multiple early-game towers like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Cowboy]] or [[Golden Soldier]] can also be used. *The '''Blight Walker''' leaves a healing trail as it walks, which heals enemies. **You can try to kill it quickly so that it can heal as little enemies as possible, however, its healing is not that significant *Placing cheap towers as bait can be useful to make the '''Blight Walker''' not target your better towers. Do note, however, that its ability creates an explosion. If other towers are near the distraction tower, they will still be affected. **The [[Commander]] can be used to partially mitigate its debuffs. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} BlightWalkerWalk.gif|Walking animation (25 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) BlightWalkerSpit.gif|Spitting animation (25 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} The Hexscape Trailer (HALLOWEEN) - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Blight Walker''' in the game trailer. }} ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Blight Walker''' added. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Blight Walker''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Blight Walker''' removed. {{TheNightmareRealm|[[Rotting Terror]] & [[Hex Corpse]]|Wave 8 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Rotting Terror]]|hardw1 = Wave 8 (Hard)|Blight Walker|Wave 10|[[Conjurer (Hexscape)|Conjurer]]|Wave 12}} {{Containment|[[Hex Mimic]]|Wave 9|Blight Walker|Wave 11|[[Rotting Terror]]|Wave 12}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
